CLint scaling → microsomal CLint scaled to whole-liver CLint using MPPGL (mg microsomal protein/g liver) and liver weight factors

Extraction ratio (Eh) calculation → CLh normalized to hepatic blood flow (Qh = 20.7 mL/min/kg)

IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — Scales measured microsomal CLint values for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio (Eh) using the well-stirred liver model.

Input: Dasatinib (CLint=220, fu=0.04), Bosutinib (CLint=60, fu=0.03), Imatinib (CLint=25, fu=0.04), Nilotinib (CLint=12, fu=0.01) — well-stirred model, Qh=20.7 mL/min/kg, fu_mic=1.0
Key steps:

CLint scaling → MPPGL normalization converts microsomal CLint (µL/min/mg) to whole-liver intrinsic clearance (mL/min/kg)
Well-stirred model → CLh = (Qh × fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) / (Qh + fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) per compound
Extraction ratio → Eh = CLh / Qh, flagged as low (<0.3), intermediate (0.3–0.7), or high (>0.7)


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh mL/min/kg + Eh per compound, ranked by clearance) + clearance_summary.json (model parameters, extraction class flags per TKI)
